methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing/plans page on the accessed date; where the official page geolocated outside the USA (rendering EUR) or rendered prices client-side, the USD figures were corroborated against the provider's US compare page or a dedicated 2026 pricing source recorded as corroboration. Business-email tiers are billed per user/mailbox in USD (billingModel per_seat) with the per-seat USD price and an annual-vs-monthly note; flat per-account plans use billingModel flat, and quote-only/Enterprise tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null. HIPAA/BAA are noted only where a provider publicly offers a BAA, and minutes/calls/overage fields are null for every tier since they do not apply to email hosting.

vendors.name: Google Workspace
vendors.provenance: https://workspace.google.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; the page geolocated to EUR and rendered prices client-side, so the US per-user USD figures were corroborated via Name.com's 2026 Google Workspace pricing breakdown)

plans.name: Business Starter
plans.notes: Per user/month on the annual (1-year commitment) plan; custom business email, 30 GB pooled storage per user, 100-participant video meetings, Gemini in Gmail. Flexible monthly billing is $8.40/user/mo. Max 300 users.

plans.name: Business Standard
plans.notes: Per user/month (annual commitment); everything in Starter plus 2 TB pooled storage per user, 150-participant meetings with recording, Gemini in Docs/Sheets/Meet, eSignature. Flexible monthly billing is $16.80/user/mo; max 300 users.

plans.name: Business Plus
plans.notes: Per user/month (annual commitment); 5 TB pooled storage per user, 500-participant meetings, Vault eDiscovery and retention, advanced endpoint management. Max 300 users.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only / contact sales; S/MIME encryption, DLP, 1000-participant meetings, Cloud Identity Premium, unlimited users, 5 TB+ storage with the option to request more.

vendors.name: Microsoft 365 for Business
vendors.provenance: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/business/compare-all-microsoft-365-business-products (official US compare page, accessed 2026-06-13; prices rendered server-side in USD)

plans.name: Business Basic
plans.notes: Per user/month on annual commitment; custom Exchange business email, 1 TB OneDrive per user, Teams, web/mobile Office apps only. Paid-monthly is $7.20/user/mo. Up to 300 users. Official compare page states 'save up to 16%' with yearly payment.

plans.name: Business Standard
plans.notes: Per user/month on annual commitment; everything in Basic plus desktop Office apps, custom business email, 1 TB OneDrive, Teams. Paid-monthly is $15/user/mo. Up to 300 users.

plans.name: Business Premium
plans.notes: Per user/month on annual commitment; all Standard features plus advanced security with Microsoft Defender, device management and threat protection, 1 TB OneDrive. Paid-monthly is $26.40/user/mo. Up to 300 users.

vendors.name: Zoho Mail
vendors.provenance: https://www.zoho.com/mail/zohomail-pricing.html (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; the page rendered prices client-side in a non-USD locale, so the per-user USD figures were corroborated on live third-party pricing pages: Mail tiers via TopAdvisor and neo.space, Workplace tiers via StackScored)

plans.name: Mail Free
plans.notes: Forever-free for up to 5 users; 5 GB mail storage per user, custom domain email, web access only (no IMAP/POP/ActiveSync).

plans.name: Mail Lite
plans.notes: Per user/month, billed annually only (no monthly option); 5 GB (or 10 GB) mail storage per user, custom business email, IMAP/POP/ActiveSync, mobile apps, MFA.

plans.name: Mail Premium
plans.notes: Per user/month, billed annually only; 50 GB mail + 50 GB archival storage per user, S/MIME, email archiving and eDiscovery, mobile access management, white labeling.

plans.name: Workplace Standard
plans.notes: Per user/month, billed annually ($36/user/year); bundles Mail with the Workplace suite (WorkDrive, Writer, Sheet, Show, Meeting, Cliq), 30 GB mail per user plus 100 GB team storage for 3-10 users.

plans.name: Workplace Professional
plans.notes: Per user/month, billed annually ($72/user/year); full Workplace suite with 100 GB mail + 100 GB retention per user and 1 TB team storage for 3-10 users.

vendors.name: Proton Mail for Business
vendors.provenance: https://proton.me/business/plans (official business plans page, accessed 2026-06-13; the page renders prices client-side as $0.00 placeholders but the plan names, storage and custom-domain counts are present, and the per-user USD prices were corroborated via Tekpon's 2026 Proton Mail for Business pricing review which matches the live-page lineup)

plans.name: Mail Essentials
plans.notes: Per user/month on monthly billing; end-to-end encrypted mail and calendar, 15 GB per user, 3 custom domains, appointment scheduling. Annual billing is $6.99/user/mo (~13% off).

plans.name: Workspace Standard
plans.notes: Per user/month on monthly billing; encrypted Mail, Calendar, Drive and VPN with 1 TB storage per user and 15 custom domains. Annual billing is $12.99/user/mo (~13% off).

plans.name: Workspace Premium
plans.notes: Per user/month on monthly billing; full encrypted suite (Mail, Calendar, Drive, VPN, Pass) with 3 TB storage per user, 20 custom domains and Lumo AI access. Annual billing is $19.99/user/mo (20% off).

vendors.name: Fastmail
vendors.provenance: https://www.fastmail.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; the page geolocated to EUR, so the per-user USD figures were corroborated via Tekpon's 2026 Fastmail pricing review, which lists the identical $4/$6/$10 monthly and $3/$5/$9 annual tiers)

plans.name: Business Basic
plans.notes: Per user/month on monthly billing; 6 GB storage per user (5 GB mail + 1 GB files), shared addresses, calendars and company address book. Annual billing is $3/user/mo (25% off).

plans.name: Business Standard
plans.notes: Per user/month on monthly billing; 60 GB storage per user (50 GB mail + 10 GB files), custom domains, Scheduled Send, third-party app support. Annual billing is $5/user/mo (~17% off).

plans.name: Business Professional
plans.notes: Per user/month on monthly billing; 150 GB storage per user (100 GB mail + 50 GB files), adds email retention archive for legal compliance. Annual billing is $9/user/mo (10% off).

vendors.name: MXroute
vendors.provenance: https://mxroute.com/ (official site pricing, accessed 2026-06-13; prices rendered server-side in USD)

plans.name: Small
plans.notes: Billed $59/year (monthlyUsd is the annual price divided by 12); 10 GB total storage, unlimited domains and email accounts, full SMTP/IMAP/POP3, 400 emails/hr per account. Flat account pricing, not per-seat.

plans.name: Medium
plans.notes: Billed $69/year (monthlyUsd is the annual price divided by 12); 25 GB total storage, unlimited domains and accounts, full SMTP/IMAP/POP3. Most popular tier.

plans.name: Large
plans.notes: Billed $79/year (monthlyUsd is the annual price divided by 12); 50 GB total storage, unlimited domains and accounts, full SMTP/IMAP/POP3.

vendors.name: IceWarp
vendors.provenance: https://www.icewarp.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; the cloud plans rendered in EUR and the self-hosted license rendered in USD; cloud USD equivalents are not published so cloud per-user prices are recorded as null with the EUR figure noted, and only the published USD self-hosted license is given a numeric price)

plans.name: Business (Cloud)
plans.notes: Most-popular cloud tier listed at EUR 3.50/user/month on the official page; 200 GB email + 1 TB file storage per user, webmail, TeamChat, conferences, documents, desktop client and desktop Office apps. No published USD price, so monthlyUsd is null.

plans.name: License Subscription (Self-Hosted)
plans.notes: Published at $30/user/year (monthlyUsd is the annual price divided by 12) for self-hosted deployment; 200 GB email per mailbox, full collaboration feature set, one month free.

plans.name: Custom Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only / contact sales; all features optional, aimed at corporates, public sector, EDU and web hosters.
